body:
Takes the "0.1 mm step near the feasible edge" next step of `simdesign-widerweb`. 189 FE solves (3 meshes x 3 radii x 21 widths). Finding: peak stress is not monotone in w at 0.1 mm; residual jitter 0.9-2.4 MPa is the size of the gap to the limit just below each edge, so the earlier 0.5 mm refinement shift is not separated from mesh noise. Stylised, preliminary, simulated only; source of the jitter not identified.

Checks: 7 tests pass, `python3 site/build.py` prints ok (441 projects). All README numbers come from `experiments/edgescan.txt/json`. No new citations beyond the scikit-fem JOSS paper already used by the parent project.
